programme.desc: Deadly Deeds: Experience abilities beyond human limits. Crocodiles sensing tiny movements, pigeons using their internal GPS and dolphins hunting with a seventh sense. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Wild Animal Babies
programme.desc: Single Kids: Patrick Aryee looks at how single offspring depend on one critical life companion - their mother, who will go to extraordinary lengths to care for them. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Wild Animal Babies
programme.desc: Brothers & Sisters: Patrick Aryee explores how some siblings quickly forge lifelong bonds, while others compete ferociously from the moment they're born. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Wild Animal Babies
programme.desc: Outnumbered: For animals born in bulk, life is a battle from the very start. Patrick marvels at the many strategies nature has come up with to raise the next generation. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Obama And Attenborough
programme.desc: In celebration of his 100th birthday, we look back to naturalist Sir David Attenborough and President Barack Obama as they talk careers and the record-breaking Great Barrier Reef dive.

programme.title: Attenborough's Flying Monsters
programme.desc: David Attenborough embarks on a journey into the past to explore the ancient world of the pterosaur, a remarkable flying monster that ruled the skies 200 million years ago.

programme.title: David Attenborough's...
programme.desc: ...Natural History Museum Alive. To celebrate Sir David Attenborough's 100th birthday, join him on an after-hours stroll around the British institution as its wonders come to life.

programme.title: Deadly Australians
programme.desc: Forests: From the oceans and the forest to swamps and deserts, Australia is home to many of the world's most toxic, venomous and dangerous creatures. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Wolves & Lions: Old Enemies
programme.desc: An Eternal Duel: Canids and felines deploy an arsenal of hunting skills. Felines face endurance, while wolves rely on their privileged sense of smell in a fight for survival. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Land Of The Far North
programme.desc: North of the Arctic Circle, the sun hardly sets in summer. Food is abundant, but animals and plants alike face great challenges such as sleep deprivation, pests and predators. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Land Of The Far North
programme.desc: In winter, cold and darkness dominate the Arctic Circle, but nature copes astonishingly well. Discover how plants and animals survive these brutal conditions. (S1, ep 2)
